_meta: Extended Data items: label -> one-line content, status, and the file that holds it. 'partly built' means a panel is a labelled placeholder because its data are not in the pulled set; a citation to that panel has to say so.

ed_fig1.description: Validation of the interatomic potential: force-parity RMSE by regime, and the NVE energy-drift bound against its gate.

placeholder_needs.b: per-configuration force differences for the two comparisons; no file in the pull holds them, and the quoted ~49 and ~376 meV/A appear nowhere in it
placeholder_needs.c: the finite-size sweep output; convergence/03_md_sampling/finite_size.py is present but its results are not. The README records only the verdict ('flat over a 32x volume range, 64 -> 2048; 6400 OOM'd')

ed_fig2.description: Planck-mean opacity over the 52 computed points, and the first-principles / HITEMP Planck ratio on the same axes.

ed_fig3.description: Line-list conventions: kappa_R under three broadening pressures, the MT_CKD self-continuum share of kappa_R, and the band-truncation ratio over the line-list grid.

ed_fig4.description: Density dependence of the absorption: the dilute-limit band-integrated absorption ratio at nine states and kappa(nu) at two of them (a, b); then alpha/rho^2 against density at three places in the spectrum, the local and fitted power-law index by source, and the mean-free-path breakdown map with the published tables' documented limits (c-i).

ed_fig5.description: Dipole-model validation: dipole derivatives against revPBE0 at two bond lengths, the model/DFT ratio per mode, and the dipole-model residual autocorrelation.

ed_fig6.description: The 108 scanned planets: boundary positions against the computed grid by category, and the dispute ratio against the factor that would flip each analysed boundary.

ed_fig7.description: External anchor: model radius against the published relation at the matched points, and the residual against water mass fraction.

ed_fig8.description: Evolution: radius, interior entropy and deepest-boundary density against age for three water worlds under both opacities.

ed_table1.description: The 52 state points: first-principles Planck and Rosseland means and the ratios to each line-list reference.

ed_table2.description: The ten strongest boundaries: state, both opacities, dispute ratio, flip threshold, shift and the provenance of the first-principles value.
